Name: Food Buff Multiplier
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[u][b][size=5]Overview[/size][/b][/u]

By default, this mod multiplies food effect by 2x.

Each food effect multiplier can be changed individually in the config:

[list]
[*]Duration[/*]
[*]Health[/*]
[*]Energy[/*]
[*]Skill[/*]
[*]MaxStamina[/*]
[*]MagneticRadius[/*]
[*]Speed[/*]
[*]Defense[/*]
[*]Attack[/*]
[*]Immunity[/*]
[*]KnockbackMultiplier[/*]
[*]WeaponSpeedMultiplier[/*]
[*]CriticalChanceMultiplier[/*]
[*]CriticalPowerMultiplier[/*]
[*]WeaponPrecisionMultiplier[/*]
[/list]
[u][b][size=5]Config[/size][/b][/u]

Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to set config variables.


[u][b][size=5]Technical[/size][/b][/u]

Requires SMAPI.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Translations should use config variable names as the keys, adding .Desc to the end of the key for hover descriptions.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
